label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value contains attacker-controlled data with incomplete sanitization. User input from request.getParameter flows to bar via param.replace("\"", """). While double quotes are escaped to ", angle brackets (<, >) remain unencoded in the HTML attribute context. An attacker can inject script tags using angle brackets (e.g., "><script>) which bypasses the quote-only escaping and executes arbitrary JavaScript.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter flows to bar via replace, then bar is unsafely concatenated into HTML attribute without full encoding
